\section{Assumptions, conditions, and unavailable authority}
\label{sec:assumptions}

The equations are conditional on the following explicit statements. They are
not permissions to replace missing information with defaults.

\begin{description}[style=nextline]
\item[\Assump{001}: upstream sample authority.]
  The supplied sample axis, time, eligibility, original/synthesized state,
  elevation/airmass meaning, and acquisition-column binding are correct under
  approved upstream authority. Ordinary \code{xs} is dimensionless KID
  \(\Delta f/f_{\rm res}\), positive with increasing absorbed optical power,
  with no absolute DC sensitivity. The fitted resonance is expected to match
  the active probe tone. Wrong-Tune and high-noise quality states are explicit.

\item[\Assump{002}: ordinary measured channel.]
  The admitted signal is the ordinary \code{xs} stream. A distinct measured
  stream is a distinct physical observable and does not inherit this factor.

\item[\Assump{003}: selected immutable child APT.]
  Beammap/source-APT production owns the generating calibration record.
  TolProj has supplied one admitted target-to-source association and selected
  or created one immutable observation-specific child APT, with an identity
  transformation recorded when the source row is unchanged. TolTECA delivery
  preserves that exact artifact. SCI-CAL does not choose the artifact,
  matcher, or transformation and does not reinterpret the selected value.

\item[\Assump{004}: no additive CAL operation.]
  SCI-CAL performs no baseline or offset subtraction. PTC is downstream and
  owns DC removal and correlated-atmosphere/common-mode cleaning.

\item[\Assump{005}: coefficient direction and reference plane.]
  The selected \code{flxscale} is finite, nonzero, oriented as
  \(\mjybeam/(\Delta f/f)\), and refers to the top-of-atmosphere calibration plane. Its
  producer record states calibrator model/epoch, source atmosphere, amplitude
  estimator, beam/template normalization, pointing and spectral treatment,
  direction, and uncertainty/covariance status. Its child lineage states the
  approved transformation, transfer-validity domain, retained systematics,
  and disposition of any pointing-source photometric rescale. SCI-BEAM owns
  the generating source-factor meaning; TolProj owns only the admitted child
  transformation and its lineage.

\item[\Assump{006}: atmosphere inputs.]
  \(\tau_{225}\) is dimensionless zenith optical depth from the LMT WVR values
  written into the observation's \code{tel*.nc} file. The approximately
  five-minute readings are interpolated onto sample time. $X$ is the full
  eligible-sample airmass and the target pivot is $X_{\rm ref}=0$.

\item[\Assump{007}: fixed conditional state.]
  Conditional covariance equations hold at fixed identities, factor values,
  atmosphere state, selection, and response state. Dependence of fitted state
  on the same signal requires cross-covariance or joint propagation.

\item[\Assump{008}: response ownership.]
  Beammap/source-APT production supplies the originating beam/template and
  source-calibration identity; MAP/FLT supplies the realized
  mapmaker/kernel/filter response. SCI-CAL records and conditions on those
  identities but does not certify their empirical fidelity or reinterpret
  their producer-owned meaning.

\item[\Assump{009}: coherent observation class.]
  CAL assigns one opacity quality class to the complete observation and does
  not split an observation into science and engineering pieces. A 0.025
  tolerance prevents momentary excursions from invalidating the observation;
  it does not extend the numerical operator's sample support.

\item[\Assump{010}: passband limitation.]
  The selected TolTECA v1 passband set is a modeled array-named reference with
  the recorded unknowns in Section~\ref{sec:definitions}. The operator uses
  its supplied energy-weighted throughput with denominator normalization and
  the selected reference spectrum. Passband uncertainty and detector/network
  variation remain unavailable.

\item[\Assump{011}: content-bound numeric operator authority.]
  The adopted machine contract and node table for
  \code{am12_fixed_djf25_piecewise_linear_los_tau_v1} are content-bound by:
  \begin{center}\footnotesize
  \code{7a064ff768a3de4f427f1338d94ef6cb9026d248f3c3c816fc3dfc96d156e36a}\\
  \code{fd688a4cd3f46585b08631bc63a562aed482feb9b24ec9ee0071b70db7eb8a5f}.
  \end{center}
  The first is the contract digest and the second the node-table digest.
  This authorizes numerical representation on declared support; it does not
  establish WVR truth, observational accuracy, or scientific acceptance.
\end{description}
